decisions: The calculation logic must live in src/split.ts and the UI must consume that module.
Use integer cents in the pure calculation so exact-sum behavior can be guaranteed.
Tax and tip are computed from the rounded subtotal in cents, not the raw input, so sub-cent amounts lost to rounding cannot reappear as tax or tip.
Rounding remainder is allocated by the largest-remainder method with ties broken by ascending index, making shares a deterministic function of the inputs.
tipBasis defaults to 'subtotal' (tip on the pre-tax amount); 'postTax' is opt-in.
concerns: Need evidence that rounding is deterministic and that shares sum exactly to the computed total in cents.
Need verification that both npm test and npm run build pass without errors.
Need to confirm the chosen API from src/split.ts is straightforward for src/main.ts to consume.
Task 3 still owns the committed Vitest coverage; src/split.test.ts currently only covers toCents.
